description.value:
Duration constant

You know exactly where the seam is, and you have never once thrown one straight.

When you critically hit with a thrown Graft, apply that Graft's critical specialization effect (if any) in addition to its normal critical effect. If the Graft has no critical specialization effect defined, it instead deals 1d6 additional damage of its own type on a critical hit.

cinderfall.incomplete: The 1d6 bonus crit damage clause resembles DamageDice (a real key, confirmed in use at pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/ancestry/automaton/level-1/energy-beam.json) but no minimal example close enough in shape was found to draft literal JSON without guessing unverified field values -- reported as plausibly buildable, not confidently drafted, so nothing is shipped. "Apply the Graft's critical specialization effect" is unhookable: homebrew Grafts have no defined weapon-group critical specialization to reference.
